message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for homemade lasagna—feel free to adjust quantities or add your favorite variations:

### Ingredients

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | Pinch |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | For garnish |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 (beaten) |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ¼ cup (25 g) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Nutmeg (optional) | Pinch |
| **Bechamel Sauce** | Butter | 4 tbsp (60 g) |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Nutmeg (optional) | Pinch |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2–3 cups (200–250 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Optional Additions
- **Vegetables**: Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, or bell peppers can be layered with the meat sauce.
- **Herbs**: Fresh basil or oregano added to the ricotta mixture for extra flavor.
- **Spices**: A splash of red wine in the meat sauce or a dash of smoked paprika.

Enjoy building your lasagna! If you’d like a step-by-step guide on how to assemble and bake it, just let me know.
